annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it documents someone presenting court-related documents at an RBC branch and seeking a signature acknowledging receipt. The described interaction concerns document service rather than an investment return, payment demand, data-collection request, or audience-directed participation mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central activity is an ordinary operational demonstration or documentation of serving legal papers at a business location, supported by the narration describing the documents and service and by frames showing paperwork being handled and signed.
